project_type: Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4 marketplace site
build_system: Next.js 16 with Turbopack. No tailwind.config — Tailwind 4 loaded via `@import 'tailwindcss'` inside app/globals.css. postcss.config.mjs uses @tailwindcss/postcss. Path alias @/* maps to project root.
verification_instructions: cd /Users/mac/Desktop/oilinga && yarn build — must exit 0 with '✓ Generating static pages' and no TypeScript errors.
environment_constraints: Worktree is at /Users/mac/Desktop/oilinga. NEVER write files outside it. Never restart a dev server. yarn build must pass before any commit.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md. Key rules: (1) 'use client' only for hooks/events; (2) ALL CSS from assets/styles/*.css via oi-* classes — no Tailwind utilities, no inline styles; (3) @/ path aliases; (4) no new npm packages; (5) wrap all localStorage reads in try/catch + SSR guard (typeof window !== 'undefined').
key_patterns: 1. CSS: add new classes to assets/styles/app.css under '/* Phase 3 */' section. Use CSS vars from assets/styles/tokens.css only — never hardcoded hex. 2. Server components by default; client components only when they use hooks or browser events. 3. Route group (site): all public pages live in app/(site)/. 4. New interfaces go in lib/types.ts. 5. localStorage keys: oilinga.cart (CartProvider), oilinga.session (AuthProvider), oilinga.accounts (AuthProvider), oilinga_orders (new), oilinga_wishlist (new), oilinga_reviews (new). 6. Illustrations: /public/assets/illustrations/ — use plain for SVGs, NOT Next.js . 7. Auth guard pattern: useEffect checking `ready && !user`, redirect to /login?next=[path] — see components/auth/AccountView.tsx. 8. Badge tones: 'pending', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'green', 'neutral', 'gold', 'red', 'blue'. 9. Icon names in Icon.tsx: bag, heart, receipt, user, settings, grid, check, star, truck, shield, headset, package, arrow-right, arrow-left, plus, logout, mail, lock, calendar, close, chevron-right, pin, filter. 10. SellerDashboard.tsx is the canonical reference for .oi-dashboard/.oi-sidebar/.oi-sidebar__link/.oi-sidebar__nav/.oi-metrics/.oi-metric/.oi-dash-card/.oi-table/.oi-table-wrap/.oi-card-head layout.
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js App Router root. app/(site)/ — route group for all public pages; currently has: /, /marketplace, /shops, /shops/[slug], /products/[slug], /login, /signup, /seller, /account, /about. app/layout.tsx — root layout: ToastProvider > AuthProvider > CartProvider > children. components/auth/ — AuthProvider, AuthForm, AccountView. components/layout/ — SiteHeader, SiteFooter. components/marketplace/ — ProductCard, ShopCard, AddToCart, FilterPanel, RouteSearch, QuerySelect, CategoryGrid, TrustRow, SellerBanner. components/ui/ — Button, ButtonLink, Badge, Icon, Toast, Breadcrumbs, Section, StarRating, SearchField, SearchBar. components/views/ — HomeView, SellerDashboard, AboutView. lib/ — cn.ts, data.ts, types.ts, cart-context.tsx, search-params.ts. assets/styles/ — tokens.css, base.css, components.css, layouts.css, app.css. public/assets/ — icons/, illustrations/, brand/, app-icons/. Illustrations confirmed: empty-cart.svg, no-orders.svg, no-products.svg, payment-success.svg.
